meta.name: build-routine
meta.description: Auto-derive a complete sales routine — installed frameworks, schedules, and default dashboard — from your archetype, available providers, and rich context, then install it on confirmation. Hybrid runtime: the proposal is import-direct (~700ms median, deterministic rule-based), the install is shell-out (writes to ~/.gtm-os/routine.yaml + config.yaml). Use when the user says 'build my sales routine', 'show me what YALC would auto-configure', 'propose a routine for me', 'set up a sales routine', or 'auto-derive my routine'. Side-effecting on install only — propose is read-only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 此技能会根据你的销售角色、已配置的供应商和上下文，自动生成一套完整的销售例行程序提案（框架、日程和默认仪表盘），然后询问你确认是否安装。确认后，它会写入配置文件。
howto.when: 当你提到“构建我的销售例行程序”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 为我建议一套销售例行程序。
say.note: 技能将生成提案并展示给你。

say.text: 分析我的角色并配置例行程序。
say.note: 技能根据你的角色生成提案。

howto.what_en: This skill automatically generates a complete sales routine proposal (frameworks, schedules, and a default dashboard) based on your archetype, configured providers, and context, then asks for confirmation before installing it to config files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like 'build my sales routine' or similar. Not for full onboarding or campaign launch.

say_en.text: Suggest a sales routine for me.
say_en.note: The skill will generate and display the proposal.

say_en.text: Analyze my archetype and set up the routine.
say_en.note: It will generate a proposal tailored to your role.
